recipes.name: Bahian bread and shrimp stew
recipes.description: A thick coconut and peanut sauce with shrimp, bread and palm oil.
instructions: Soak bread in coconut milk until soft
blend smooth
Cook onion and tomato in dendê oil until soft
Add bread mixture and peanuts
simmer, stirring, until thick
Add shrimp and cook until opaque
season with lime and salt.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice or use as acaraje filling.
recipes.substitutions: Use cashews instead of peanuts, noting allergen change.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Keep shrimp chilled and cook until opaque; check nut allergies.

recipes.name: Bahian fish and coconut stew
recipes.description: Fish gently simmered with tomato, peppers, coconut milk and palm oil.
instructions: Season fish with lime and salt
Cook onion, pepper and tomatoes in dendê oil until softened
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes
Nestle fish into sauce and simmer gently until opaque and flakes
finish with cilantro.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and farofa.
recipes.substitutions: Use neutral oil and paprika if dendê is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Keep raw fish chilled and cook just until opaque.

recipes.name: Beans with cassava flour and greens
recipes.description: Beans tossed with toasted cassava flour, eggs, greens and optional bacon.
instructions: Fry bacon until crisp
add onion and soften
Add greens and cook until wilted
push aside
scramble eggs in pan
Fold in beans and warm through
Sprinkle manioc flour gradually, tossing until crumbly
season.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and orange slices.
recipes.substitutions: Omit bacon and add mushrooms.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs fully and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Beef and cassava stew
recipes.description: Beef braised with cassava until the root softens into the rich broth.
instructions: Brown beef in oil in batches
add onion and garlic
Stir in tomato, cumin and stock
cover and simmer until beef is nearly tender, about 60 minutes
Add cassava and cook until both beef and cassava are soft
season and add hot water if broth thickens too much.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and chopped cilantro.
recipes.substitutions: Use potatoes if cassava is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Remove the fibrous cassava core and cook cassava fully.

recipes.name: Beef ribs with cassava
recipes.description: Beef ribs braised until tender with cassava that thickens the cooking broth.
instructions: Brown ribs in oil on all sides
add onion, garlic and tomato
Add stock and bay
cover and braise gently until ribs nearly tender, about 90 minutes
Add cassava and continue simmering until both are soft and broth thickens
season and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and greens.
recipes.substitutions: Use beef chuck and reduce cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Cook ribs until tender; remove cassava fibres before serving.

recipes.name: Black bean and pork stew
recipes.description: Slow-cooked black beans with pork and sausage, served with rice and greens.
instructions: Drain beans
simmer with pork and bay in fresh water until beginning to soften
Brown bacon and sausage
add onion and garlic and cook until tender
Add meat mixture to beans and cook gently until beans are creamy and pork is tender
season and remove bay
serve with rice and greens.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice, farofa, orange slices and sauteed collard greens.
recipes.substitutions: Use smoked tofu and mushrooms for a meat-free bean stew.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 4 days; reheat until boiling and steaming.
recipes.safety: Soak beans refrigerated when warm; boil beans thoroughly and cook pork through.

recipes.name: Black-eyed pea fritters
recipes.description: Split pea fritters fried in palm oil, traditionally split and filled with vatapa and salad.
ingredients: dende or neutral oil for frying
instructions: Drain soaked peas and rub away most skins
rinse well
Grind peas with onion and salt to a thick fluffy paste
Beat mixture until aerated
form oval spoonfuls and fry carefully in hot oil, turning until cooked and deep golden
Drain and split for filling.
recipes.sides: Fill with vatapa, tomato salad and chilli sauce.
recipes.substitutions: Use neutral oil if dendê is unavailable, noting the flavour changes.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate batter no more than 1 day.
recipes.safety: Use a stable deep pan; keep water away from hot oil and cook fritters through.

recipes.name: Brazilian beef and tomato stew
recipes.description: Small beef cubes simmered with tomato, carrots and potatoes for a weekday meal.
instructions: Brown beef in oil in batches
add onion and garlic
Add tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer 30 minutes
Add carrots and potatoes and cook until tender
season and finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice, beans and farofa.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs, adjusting cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until hot throughout.
recipes.safety: Cook beef until tender and keep leftovers chilled.

recipes.name: Brazilian condensed milk flan
recipes.description: Silky baked custard with a clear caramel sauce, chilled before unmoulding.
instructions: Melt sugar with water in a saucepan until amber
pour carefully into a ring mould
Blend condensed milk, milk and eggs briefly
strain into mould
Cover with foil and bake in a water bath at 160 C until just set, 50 to 60 minutes
Chill fully before unmoulding.
recipes.sides: Serve cold with caramel.
recipes.substitutions: Use plant-based condensed milk for a dairy-free variation.
recipes.storage: Keep covered and refrigerated up to 3 days.
recipes.safety: Bake custard until set; cool quickly and keep chilled.

recipes.name: Cassava and kale soup
recipes.description: A home-style soup of mashed cassava, greens and smoked sausage.
instructions: Simmer cassava in stock until very soft
remove woody fibres
Mash or blend with some broth
Cook onion, garlic and sausage in oil until fragrant
Add cassava puree and enough stock for a thick soup
simmer 10 minutes
Fold in kale and cook until tender.
recipes.sides: Serve with crusty bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use beans or smoked tofu instead of sausage.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook sausage thoroughly and stir soup while reheating.

recipes.name: Cassava starch crepes
recipes.description: A naturally gluten-free crepe made by sprinkling hydrated tapioca starch onto a hot pan.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat
Sieve starch into an even thin layer
cook until it binds into a flexible disc
Add cheese or coconut to one half
fold and cook briefly until filling warms
Serve immediately.
recipes.sides: Fill with cheese, coconut or banana.
recipes.substitutions: Use ready-hydrated tapioca starch from a shop.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; do not store assembled crepes.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy fillings chilled until cooking.

recipes.name: Cheese bread rolls
recipes.description: Chewy baked rolls made with tapioca starch and cheese.
ingredients: 120 g grated Minas cheese or Parmesan
instructions: Heat milk and oil until steaming
pour over starch and stir
cool 10 minutes
Beat in egg, cheese and salt until a sticky dough forms
Roll into small balls with oiled hands
Bake at 200 C for 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use a mix of mozzarella and Parmesan.
recipes.storage: Freeze shaped uncooked balls; bake from frozen adding a few minutes.
recipes.safety: Cool before serving; cheese filling stays hot.

recipes.name: Chicken and rice
recipes.description: One-pot chicken and rice coloured with annatto and finished with herbs.
instructions: Season chicken
brown in oil on all sides and set aside
Cook onion, garlic and tomato until soft
stir in rice and annatto
Return chicken and add stock
cover and simmer low until rice is tender and chicken cooked
rest 5 minutes
finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with salad and hot sauce.
recipes.substitutions: Use boneless thighs and reduce cooking time slightly.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook chicken through; cool rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.name: Chicken with okra
recipes.description: Chicken braised with okra, garlic and herbs, served with rice and angu.
instructions: Pat chicken dry, season and brown in oil on all sides; set aside.
Cook onion, garlic and tomatoes until soft; stir in paprika and stock; return chicken and simmer covered until nearly cooked.
Saute okra separately until its surface moisture reduces, then fold into pot and simmer until chicken is fully cooked and okra tender; finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice, beans or soft cornmeal angu.
recipes.substitutions: Use green beans if okra is unavailable, noting the texture differs.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot.
recipes.safety: Cook chicken fully; keep raw poultry separate from vegetables and utensils.

recipes.name: Chocolate condensed milk truffles
recipes.description: Soft chocolate sweets rolled into small balls and coated with chocolate sprinkles.
instructions: Mix condensed milk, cocoa and butter in a heavy pan
Cook on low, stirring constantly, until thick and the mixture pulls from pan, 15 to 20 minutes
Cool completely
butter hands lightly and roll small balls
coat in sprinkles.
recipes.sides: Serve in small paper cases.
recipes.substitutions: Use dark cocoa for a less sweet flavour.
recipes.storage: Keep covered and refrigerated up to 5 days.
recipes.safety: Cool mixture before handling; keep dairy sweets chilled.

recipes.name: Coconut and egg yolk custard
recipes.description: Bright yellow baked coconut custards with a glossy sugar base.
instructions: Grease small moulds well and dust with sugar
Whisk yolks, sugar, coconut, butter and water gently without foaming
Spoon into moulds
set in a hot water bath and bake at 170 C until tops are golden and centres just set
Cool, chill and unmould carefully.
recipes.sides: Serve chilled with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use pasteurised yolks if preferred.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Keep custards chilled and bake until set.

recipes.name: Coconut sweet
recipes.description: Chewy coconut and sugar sweets cooked together until thick and lightly caramelised.
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water in a heavy pan
add coconut, butter and salt
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring often, until thick and pulling from pan
Drop spoonfuls onto parchment and cool until firm.
recipes.sides: Serve with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use brown sugar for a deeper caramel flavour.
recipes.storage: Store airtight at room temperature for 3 days.
recipes.safety: Take care with hot caramel mixture.

recipes.name: Cornmeal cake
recipes.description: A simple tender cornmeal cake often served with coffee.
instructions: Heat oven to 180 C and grease a loaf tin
Whisk eggs, sugar, milk and oil
Fold in cornmeal, flour, salt and baking powder
Pour into tin and bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
recipes.sides: Serve with coffee or guava paste.
recipes.substitutions: Add fennel seeds if desired.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 2 days.
recipes.safety: Bake until centre is set; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Cracked corn with pork ribs
recipes.description: Yellow cracked corn simmered until creamy with pork ribs and herbs.
ingredients: 250 g canjiquinha or coarse cracked corn
instructions: Rinse cracked corn and soak 30 minutes if coarse
Brown ribs in a heavy pot
add onion and garlic and soften
Add tomato, corn, bay and stock
cover and simmer gently until corn is soft and ribs tender, about 75 minutes
add water if needed and season.
recipes.sides: Serve with chopped parsley and greens.
recipes.substitutions: Use smoked pork shoulder pieces if ribs are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat with water until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook pork until tender and hot throughout.

recipes.name: Crisp Brazilian market pastries
recipes.description: Thin pastry parcels filled with cheese or seasoned meat and fried until blistered.
ingredients: 200 g mozzarella or cooked minced beef
instructions: Mix flour, oil, water, vinegar and salt into a firm dough
knead and rest 20 minutes
Roll very thin
cut rectangles and add a small amount of filling
dampen edges, fold and seal firmly
Fry in hot oil in batches until blistered and golden
drain on rack.
recipes.sides: Serve with vinaigrette salsa.
recipes.substitutions: Use ready-made pastry sheets if available.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate cooked leftovers up to 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cook meat filling fully before stuffing; handle hot oil carefully.

recipes.name: Espírito Santo fish stew
recipes.description: A lighter fish stew with tomato, onion, cilantro and annatto, without coconut milk.
instructions: Season fish with lime and salt
Layer onion, tomato and pepper in a heavy pan with oil and annatto
Place fish on top and cover
simmer gently until vegetables soften and fish is opaque, about 15 minutes
add little water only if needed
finish with cilantro.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and pirão.
recipes.substitutions: Use another firm white fish; keep sauce light rather than adding coconut.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Keep fish cold and cook until opaque and flaking.

recipes.name: Grilled coalho cheese
recipes.description: Firm salty cheese grilled until golden outside and soft within.
ingredients: 400 g queijo coalho, cut into thick sticks
instructions: Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high
Grill cheese sticks, turning carefully, until marked and golden on all sides
Sprinkle with oregano and serve with lime.
recipes.sides: Serve as a snack or with rice and beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use halloumi if coalho cheese is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Best hot; do not store cooked cheese for long.
recipes.safety: Use clean tongs for cooked cheese.

recipes.name: Rain cakes
recipes.description: Small spoon-dropped cinnamon-sugar fritters made from a quick egg batter.
instructions: Whisk flour, egg, milk and sugar into a thick batter
fold in baking powder
Heat oil to 170 C
drop small spoonfuls carefully into oil and fry, turning, until golden and cooked in centre
Drain and roll in cinnamon sugar.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use plant milk if needed.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; do not store fried cakes for long.
recipes.safety: Keep hot oil attended and cook batter through the middle.

recipes.name: Rice and beans with cheese
recipes.description: Rice and beans cooked with onion, herbs and cubes of melting coalho cheese.
instructions: Soften onion and garlic in oil
Stir in rice and stock
cover and cook gently until rice is nearly tender
Fold in peas and simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed
Add cheese cubes and cilantro, cover 3 minutes to soften.
recipes.sides: Serve with farofa and greens.
recipes.substitutions: Use firm halloumi in place of coalho cheese.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Keep cooked rice chilled promptly and reheat thoroughly.

recipes.name: Rice and black beans
recipes.description: Everyday rice and beans cooked separately and served together as a familiar Brazilian meal.
ingredients: 400 g cooked black beans with broth
instructions: Cook half the garlic in a little oil
stir in rinsed rice until glossy
Add water and salt, cover and simmer low until tender
In another pan soften onion and remaining garlic
add cooked beans and broth, simmer 15 minutes and season
Serve rice and beans together.
recipes.sides: Add sauteed greens, egg or grilled meat.
recipes.substitutions: Use pinto beans if black beans are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours; use beans within 4 days and rice within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cool rice quickly; reheat each component once until steaming.

recipes.name: Sao Paulo beans with cassava flour
recipes.description: Mashed beans thickened with cassava flour and served with rice, greens and egg.
ingredients: 400 g cooked carioca beans with broth
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in oil until soft
Add beans and mash roughly
stir in manioc flour gradually until thick
Saute greens separately
fry eggs and serve alongside beans, rice and greens.
recipes.sides: Add banana or sausage as a side.
recipes.substitutions: Use black beans or omit egg for vegan version.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate beans promptly up to 3 days.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs fully; reheat beans until steaming.

recipes.name: Sao Paulo savoury corn couscous
recipes.description: Seasoned cornmeal steamed with vegetables, olives and optional sardines.
instructions: Cook onion and pepper in oil until soft
add chopped tomatoes, peas, corn and stock
simmer 10 minutes
Slowly stir in flaked cornmeal until thick and pulling from the pan
Fold in sardines and parsley if using
Press into an oiled ring mould with sliced tomato and olives
steam 20 minutes
cool slightly and unmould.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or at room temperature with salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use hearts of palm instead of sardines.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Keep fish filling chilled before cooking and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Shrimp and cassava stew
recipes.description: Creamy shrimp stew thickened with cassava and flavoured with coconut and palm oil.
instructions: Boil cassava in salted water until very soft
remove any fibrous core and mash with some cooking liquid
Cook onion, pepper and tomato in oil until soft
add coconut milk and cassava puree
simmer until creamy
Add shrimp and cook gently until opaque
finish with lime and cilantro.
recipes.sides: Serve with white rice.
recipes.substitutions: Use neutral oil and a little paprika instead of dendê.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Keep raw shrimp cold; cook only until opaque and avoid cross-contamination.

recipes.name: Sweet hominy pudding
recipes.description: White corn hominy simmered with milk, coconut and cinnamon for a warm dessert.
ingredients: 300 g dried white hominy, soaked overnight
instructions: Drain hominy and simmer in fresh water until tender, 60 to 90 minutes
Drain most water
Add milk, coconut milk, sugar, cinnamon, cloves and coconut
simmer gently 20 minutes until creamy
remove spices and serve warm or chilled.
recipes.sides: Dust with cinnamon.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned hominy and shorten cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 3 days.
recipes.safety: Keep milk mixture at a gentle simmer and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Toasted cassava flour
recipes.description: Cassava flour toasted in butter with onion for a crumbly savoury accompaniment.
instructions: Melt butter in a wide pan and cook onion until soft
Add manioc flour and stir continuously over medium-low heat until toasted and fragrant
Season, fold in parsley and serve warm.
recipes.sides: Serve beside beans, grilled meat or stews.
recipes.substitutions: Use olive oil for a dairy-free version; add egg or bacon if wanted.
recipes.storage: Keep dry and covered; use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Stir constantly to prevent scorching.
